style.styleTitle: Scottish Everlastings Ltd Artificial 2ft Holly Christmas Tree
style.toneOfVoice: Enhance your home decor with our 60cm Natural Artificial Holly Tree, featuring delicate white flowers and leaves that will bring a touch of elegance to any room. This charming tree is adorned with cream and brown holly leaves, complemented by cream berries for a realistic look that will last all year round. The tree is securely placed in a hessian base, adding a rustic touch to its overall design. Perfect for adding a pop to your living space without the hassle of maintenance, this artificial holly tree is a must-have for any plant lover.
